# Momentum working agreement

Momentum is an individual's noncommercial hobby project with a limited token
budget. Focus on requested engineering work. Do not initiate legal reviews,
licensing research, rights audits, permission questionnaires or research agents
unless explicitly requested; a coding/publication request is not a legal-audit
request. Preserve notices, record known attribution and unknowns honestly, and
respect recorded owner decisions without reopening them. Documentation gaps are
follow-up, not automatic new release gates. If a concrete new conflict genuinely
prevents an action, explain it briefly and ask for direction without launching an
investigation. Do not invent permissions or claim complete legal clearance.

For example, support an accepted OpenBOR package by validating exact runtime and
package bytes, approvals, lifecycle and player-state preservation, not by starting
a bundled-library legal research project. The owner handles broader rights
follow-up separately.

Keep changes game-driven and bounded. Reuse existing helpers and known-good
setups; extract shared logic when actual games need it. Add another pinned engine
build only when a real title needs it. Defer speculative automatic fallback,
upgrades, migrations and universal controller mapping. Ask before materially
expanding scope or spending substantial effort outside the requested task.
Separate installer validation from reported gameplay acceptance.

Preserve working engines, settings, saves and edited library entries. The
canonical laptop checkout is this repository; launcher development remains
private, while approved game packages are published separately.
